units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|log|19|0
units.english: The Quarg are tall, thin, inscrutable aliens who evolved on a very small planet and can live comfortably on worlds with atmosphere so thin that a human being could not breathe it. They discovered spaceflight millions of years ago. Many of them live on artificially constructed ringworlds, including one in human space. They live at peace with most sentient species and claim to be in communication with an even older species named the Drak.
units.italian: I Quarg sono alieni alti, sottili e imperscrutabili, evoluti su un pianeta molto piccolo, e possono vivere comodamente su mondi con un'atmosfera così sottile che un essere umano non potrebbe respirarla. Hanno scoperto il volo spaziale milioni di anni fa. Molti di loro vivono su mondi ad anello costruiti artificialmente, compreso uno nello spazio umano. Vivono in pace con la maggior parte delle specie senzienti e affermano di essere in comunicazione con una specie ancora più antica, chiamata Drak.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|log|20|0
units.english: The Drak are supposedly the oldest living species in the galaxy. The Quarg say that the Drak act as something like galactic peacekeepers or police, and will intervene if a species invents a weapon so terrible that it could drive that species to extinction.
units.italian: I Drak sarebbero la specie vivente più antica della galassia. I Quarg dicono che i Drak agiscono come una sorta di pacificatori o poliziotti galattici, e intervengono se una specie inventa un'arma così terribile da poterla portare all'estinzione.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|You had seen pictures and videos of the Quarg before, but this is your first time in a spaceport that is owned by them. The architecture is truly alien: uncomfortably tall ceilings, strange colors, and walls that never quite seem to meet at right angles. The Quarg themselves are equally strange, towering above you, some nearly three meters tall. Their legs bend backwards at the bottom, like a dog walking on its hind feet, and they move gracefully and almost silently.|22|0
units.english: You had seen pictures and videos of the Quarg before, but this is your first time in a spaceport that is owned by them. The architecture is truly alien: uncomfortably tall ceilings, strange colors, and walls that never quite seem to meet at right angles. The Quarg themselves are equally strange, towering above you, some nearly three meters tall. Their legs bend backwards at the bottom, like a dog walking on its hind feet, and they move gracefully and almost silently.
units.italian: Avevate già visto immagini e video dei Quarg, ma è la prima volta che entrate in uno spazioporto di loro proprietà. L'architettura è davvero aliena: soffitti scomodamente alti, colori strani e pareti che non sembrano mai incontrarsi ad angolo retto. I Quarg stessi sono altrettanto strani: torreggiano su di voi, alcuni alti quasi tre metri. Le loro gambe si piegano all'indietro in basso, come un cane che cammina sulle zampe posteriori, e si muovono con grazia e quasi in silenzio.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	Most of the Quarg you see are dressed entirely in shades of gray, or only slight hints of color. Quarg fashion seems to revolve not around color, but texture: coarse and fine woven fabrics, patterns like lizard scales or cobblestones, and occasional decorative fringes of sponge-like material. Their skin is deep gray, sometimes with a hint of green or blue or brown beneath it, with a fine scale pattern like a reptile. But what makes their eyes startling is that they look very human, except that some of them have gold or violet irises instead of green or blue or brown. They have no hair, but many are wearing small cloth caps or hoods.|23|0
units.english: Most of the Quarg you see are dressed entirely in shades of gray, or only slight hints of color. Quarg fashion seems to revolve not around color, but texture: coarse and fine woven fabrics, patterns like lizard scales or cobblestones, and occasional decorative fringes of sponge-like material. Their skin is deep gray, sometimes with a hint of green or blue or brown beneath it, with a fine scale pattern like a reptile. But what makes their eyes startling is that they look very human, except that some of them have gold or violet irises instead of green or blue or brown. They have no hair, but many are wearing small cloth caps or hoods.
units.italian: La maggior parte dei Quarg che vedete è vestita interamente in tonalità di grigio, o solo con lievi accenni di colore. La moda Quarg sembra ruotare non intorno al colore, ma alla trama: tessuti grossolani e fini, motivi come squame di lucertola o ciottoli, e occasionali frange decorative di materiale spugnoso. La loro pelle è grigio scuro, a volte con un accenno di verde, blu o marrone sotto, con un fine disegno a squame come quello di un rettile. Ma ciò che rende sconcertanti i loro occhi è che sembrano molto umani, tranne che alcuni hanno iridi d'oro o viola invece che verdi, blu o marroni. Non hanno capelli, ma molti indossano piccoli berretti di stoffa o cappucci.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	One of the Quarg notices you gawking at them and walks over. It squats down on its haunches so that its eyes are level with your own, and says, "Hello." Its voice is deep, sounding like an accordion or the buzz of a beehive blended with the hum of a starship engine.|24|0
units.english: One of the Quarg notices you gawking at them and walks over. It squats down on its haunches so that its eyes are level with your own, and says, "Hello." Its voice is deep, sounding like an accordion or the buzz of a beehive blended with the hum of a starship engine.
units.italian: Uno dei Quarg si accorge che lo state fissando a bocca aperta e si avvicina. Si accovaccia sui garretti finché i suoi occhi non sono all'altezza dei vostri e dice: "Salve." La sua voce è profonda, e suona come una fisarmonica o il ronzio di un alveare mescolato al sibilo del motore di una nave.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"Hello."|26|0
units.english: "Hello."
units.italian: "Salve."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	Speaking slowly and deliberately, it says, "I think you are new here. Are you what is called a tourist?"|27|0
units.english: Speaking slowly and deliberately, it says, "I think you are new here. Are you what is called a tourist?"
units.italian: Parlando lentamente e con deliberazione, dice: "Credo che tu sia nuovo qui. Sei quello che chiamano un turista?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"Yes."|29|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"No, I'm a merchant captain, I'm here to buy and sell cargo."|30|0
units.english: "No, I'm a merchant captain, I'm here to buy and sell cargo."
units.italian: "No, sono un capitano mercantile, sono qui per comprare e vendere carico."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"I see." The Quarg blinks slowly. Its eyelids come from the sides of its eyes, instead of up and down. In an otherwise so human eye, the effect is disconcerting. "Many humans have many questions when they see us, and we the Quarg live for many lifetimes of humans, so it is not burdensome for this one to speak with you."|31|0
units.english: "I see." The Quarg blinks slowly. Its eyelids come from the sides of its eyes, instead of up and down. In an otherwise so human eye, the effect is disconcerting. "Many humans have many questions when they see us, and we the Quarg live for many lifetimes of humans, so it is not burdensome for this one to speak with you."
units.italian: "Capisco." Il Quarg sbatte le palpebre lentamente. Le sue palpebre vengono dai lati degli occhi, invece che dall'alto e dal basso. In un occhio per il resto così umano, l'effetto è sconcertante. "Molti umani hanno molte domande quando ci vedono, e noi Quarg viviamo per molte vite umane, quindi non è un peso per questo uno parlare con te."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"Can you tell me about the Quarg?"|35|0
units.english: "Can you tell me about the Quarg?"
units.italian: "Mi puoi parlare dei Quarg?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"Are there other alien species in the galaxy?"|37|0
units.english: "Are there other alien species in the galaxy?"
units.italian: "Ci sono altre specie aliene nella galassia?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"It is an honor to speak with you, but I do not have any questions."|38|0
units.english: "It is an honor to speak with you, but I do not have any questions."
units.italian: "È un onore parlare con te, ma non ho domande."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"Many. Most of them young, so much younger than the Quarg. Many foolish. A few wise. Many travel only along the ancient roads between the stars. A few need no roads to travel by. And some reshape the galaxy at will. But the Quarg are like no other, because we have nothing that the others covet."|41|0
units.english: "Many. Most of them young, so much younger than the Quarg. Many foolish. A few wise. Many travel only along the ancient roads between the stars. A few need no roads to travel by. And some reshape the galaxy at will. But the Quarg are like no other, because we have nothing that the others covet."
units.italian: "Molte. La maggior parte giovani, molto più giovani dei Quarg. Molte sciocche. Poche sagge. Molte viaggiano solo lungo le antiche vie fra le stelle. Poche non hanno bisogno di vie per viaggiare. E alcune rimodellano la galassia a piacimento. Ma i Quarg non sono come nessun altro, perché non abbiamo nulla che gli altri bramino."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"What do you mean?"|43|0
units.english: "What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vuoi dire?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"We the Quarg are unique of all the species in the galaxy. Our species began on the moon of a great gas giant, on a planet most small, that gathered about itself very little air. We cannot step many steps on the worlds that the Hai, the Korath, the other species desire. And the worlds like our home, you could not breathe their so thin air, for our lungs are very subtle. And we are an old race, and do not kill for sport or whimsy, so the Drak gave us the gift, that we may go among the other races and settle where we please, and make friends of all, because none dare be our enemy."|46|0
units.english: "We the Quarg are unique of all the species in the galaxy. Our species began on the moon of a great gas giant, on a planet most small, that gathered about itself very little air. We cannot step many steps on the worlds that the Hai, the Korath, the other species desire. And the worlds like our home, you could not breathe their so thin air, for our lungs are very subtle. And we are an old race, and do not kill for sport or whimsy, so the Drak gave us the gift, that we may go among the other races and settle where we please, and make friends of all, because none dare be our enemy."
units.italian: "Noi Quarg siamo unici fra tutte le specie della galassia. La nostra specie è nata sulla luna di un grande gigante gassoso, su un pianeta molto piccolo, che raccoglieva intorno a sé pochissima aria. Non possiamo muovere molti passi sui mondi che gli Hai, i Korath e le altre specie desiderano. E i mondi come il nostro, voi non potreste respirarne l'aria così sottile, perché i nostri polmoni sono assai delicati. E siamo una razza antica, e non uccidiamo per diletto o per capriccio, così i Drak ci hanno dato il dono, che possiamo andare fra le altre razze e stabilirci dove vogliamo, e farci amici di tutti, perché nessuno osa essere nostro nemico."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"Who are the Drak?"|48|0
units.english: "Who are the Drak?"
units.italian: "Chi sono i Drak?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"Why do none dare to be your enemy?"|50|0
units.english: "Why do none dare to be your enemy?"
units.italian: "Perché nessuno osa esservi nemico?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"Because we are very strong, and because we speak with the Drak."|52|0
units.english: "Because we are very strong, and because we speak with the Drak."
units.italian: "Perché siamo molto forti, e perché parliamo con i Drak."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"Who are the Drak?"|54|0
units.english: "Who are the Drak?"
units.italian: "Chi sono i Drak?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"The Drak are the eldest living. Not the firstborn, for they are long gone, but the eldest living, and yet they are far younger than the stars. They tend and cultivate the pathways between the stars, and prune away the paths that any species could travel to make war against another. And they hold the secret of travel beyond those pathways, and give the secret only to a worthy few, so that peace may prevail." It taps its chest with one hand, signaling that the Quarg are among those few.|57|0
units.english: "The Drak are the eldest living. Not the firstborn, for they are long gone, but the eldest living, and yet they are far younger than the stars. They tend and cultivate the pathways between the stars, and prune away the paths that any species could travel to make war against another. And they hold the secret of travel beyond those pathways, and give the secret only to a worthy few, so that peace may prevail." It taps its chest with one hand, signaling that the Quarg are among those few.
units.italian: "I Drak sono i più anziani fra i viventi. Non i primogeniti, perché quelli sono scomparsi da tempo, ma i più anziani fra i viventi, eppure sono molto più giovani delle stelle. Curano e coltivano i sentieri fra le stelle, e potano via le vie per cui una specie potrebbe viaggiare per fare guerra a un'altra. E custodiscono il segreto del viaggio oltre quei sentieri, e lo danno solo a pochi degni, perché la pace prevalga." Si tocca il petto con una mano, segnalando che i Quarg sono fra quei pochi.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"Not that the Drak are strangers to war. Planets and moons and even stars were consumed in their wars and are no more. But then they learned wisdom, and have fought no more wars, many millions of human years. They live nearby, but they keep to themselves, and intervene in the affairs of other races only to prevent their destruction or the use of obscene technologies of war."|58|0
units.english: "Not that the Drak are strangers to war. Planets and moons and even stars were consumed in their wars and are no more. But then they learned wisdom, and have fought no more wars, many millions of human years. They live nearby, but they keep to themselves, and intervene in the affairs of other races only to prevent their destruction or the use of obscene technologies of war."
units.italian: "Non che i Drak siano estranei alla guerra. Pianeti e lune e persino stelle furono consumati nelle loro guerre e non esistono più. Ma poi appresero la saggezza, e non hanno più combattuto guerre, per molti milioni di anni umani. Vivono qui vicino, ma se ne stanno per conto loro, e intervengono negli affari delle altre razze solo per impedirne la distruzione o l'uso di oscene tecnologie di guerra."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"We humans have used some rather destructive weapons against each other, and no alien species ever stepped in to put a stop to it."|60|0
units.english: "We humans have used some rather destructive weapons against each other, and no alien species ever stepped in to put a stop to it."
units.italian: "Noi umani abbiamo usato armi piuttosto distruttive gli uni contro gli altri, e nessuna specie aliena è mai intervenuta per fermarlo."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"Well, I hope we never do anything bad enough to force them to intervene."|61|0
units.english: "Well, I hope we never do anything bad enough to force them to intervene."
units.italian: "Beh, spero che non faremo mai nulla di abbastanza brutto da costringerli a intervenire."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"You have done what? Awakened the atom? There are weapons far worse than that. Consuming planets. Snuffing out stars. Tearing the flesh of space and time itself. Weapons of chaos I pray your reckless race cannot yet even conceive of. These things will attract the attention of the Drak, because they nearly destroyed this galaxy once, and must not be allowed to do so again."|64|0
units.english: "You have done what? Awakened the atom? There are weapons far worse than that. Consuming planets. Snuffing out stars. Tearing the flesh of space and time itself. Weapons of chaos I pray your reckless race cannot yet even conceive of. These things will attract the attention of the Drak, because they nearly destroyed this galaxy once, and must not be allowed to do so again."
units.italian: "Avete fatto che cosa? Risvegliato l'atomo? Ci sono armi molto peggiori di quella. Consumare pianeti. Spegnere stelle. Strappare la carne dello spazio e del tempo stesso. Armi del caos che prego la tua razza sconsiderata non riesca nemmeno a concepire. Queste cose attireranno l'attenzione dei Drak, perché una volta hanno quasi distrutto questa galassia, e non si deve permettere che lo facciano di nuovo."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"Well, if there are technologies that dangerous out there, I hope the Drak do continue to succeed in keeping them from being used."|66|0
units.english: "Well, if there are technologies that dangerous out there, I hope the Drak do continue to succeed in keeping them from being used."
units.italian: "Beh, se là fuori ci sono tecnologie così pericolose, spero che i Drak continuino a riuscire a impedirne l'uso."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Quarg|	"I hope so too, human." The Quarg stands up, towering over you once again. "As long as you are a seeker of peace, you are most welcome on our worlds at any time." It bows to you. You are not sure if that is a Quarg gesture too, or if it is simply imitating a human custom, but you bow in return, and the Quarg walks quietly away.|69|0
units.english: "I hope so too, human." The Quarg stands up, towering over you once again. "As long as you are a seeker of peace, you are most welcome on our worlds at any time." It bows to you. You are not sure if that is a Quarg gesture too, or if it is simply imitating a human custom, but you bow in return, and the Quarg walks quietly away.
units.italian: "Lo spero anch'io, umano." Il Quarg si alza, torreggiando di nuovo su di voi. "Finché sei un cercatore di pace, sei il benvenuto sui nostri mondi in qualunque momento." Vi fa un inchino. Non siete sicuri che sia anch'esso un gesto Quarg, o che stia semplicemente imitando un'usanza umana, ma ricambiate l'inchino, e il Quarg si allontana in silenzio.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|In your past experience, you've never seen the Quarg move with anything approaching haste or excitement, but when you land on this station a group of them run up to you, moving faster than you thought they were able to. For a minute or two they just gawk at you and talk amongst themselves in their own language; you think you recognize the word "Humani," and perhaps, "Eartha."|81|0
units.english: In your past experience, you've never seen the Quarg move with anything approaching haste or excitement, but when you land on this station a group of them run up to you, moving faster than you thought they were able to. For a minute or two they just gawk at you and talk amongst themselves in their own language; you think you recognize the word "Humani," and perhaps, "Eartha."
units.italian: Per la vostra esperienza passata, non avete mai visto i Quarg muoversi con qualcosa che somigli alla fretta o all'eccitazione, ma quando atterrate su questa stazione un gruppo di loro vi corre incontro, muovendosi più velocemente di quanto pensavate fossero capaci. Per un minuto o due vi fissano e parlano fra loro nella loro lingua; credete di riconoscere la parola "Humani" e forse "Eartha".

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	Finally a Quarg appears who speaks your language, or at least is willing to try. It says, "Salutations, astonishing sojourner. Whither came you, and wherefore visit you us here in the unquiet graveyard of the Korathi?"|82|0
units.english: Finally a Quarg appears who speaks your language, or at least is willing to try. It says, "Salutations, astonishing sojourner. Whither came you, and wherefore visit you us here in the unquiet graveyard of the Korathi?"
units.italian: Alla fine compare un Quarg che parla la vostra lingua, o almeno è disposto a provarci. Dice: "Saluti, sorprendente viaggiatore. Donde venite, e perché ci visitate qui nell'inquieto cimitero dei Korathi?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"I'm just here to explore. Can you tell me more about the Korath?"|84|0
units.english: "I'm just here to explore. Can you tell me more about the Korath?"
units.italian: "Sono qui solo per esplorare. Mi puoi dire di più sui Korath?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"I came here to learn what happened to the Korath."|85|0
units.english: "I came here to learn what happened to the Korath."
units.italian: "Sono venuto a scoprire che cosa è successo ai Korath."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"Ah, the unwise Korath," it says. "Once a mighty empire, now sadly splintered and diminished. Their own thinking war machines, now breeding with abandon and inimical to all, hunt the survivors. And of them some, too, were exiled for their great crimes."|86|0
units.english: "Ah, the unwise Korath," it says. "Once a mighty empire, now sadly splintered and diminished. Their own thinking war machines, now breeding with abandon and inimical to all, hunt the survivors. And of them some, too, were exiled for their great crimes."
units.italian: "Ah, gli stolti Korath," dice. "Un tempo un impero potente, ora tristemente diviso e diminuito. Le loro macchine da guerra pensanti, che ora si riproducono senza freno e sono nemiche di tutti, danno la caccia ai superstiti. E alcuni di loro, anche, furono esiliati per i loro grandi crimini."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"What crimes did they commit?"|88|0
units.english: "What crimes did they commit?"
units.italian: "Che crimini hanno commesso?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"What do you mean, 'thinking war machines'?"|90|0
units.english: "What do you mean, 'thinking war machines'?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vuoi dire con 'macchine da guerra pensanti'?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"Robotic starships, and autonomous factories to create them. Though now directed by no living being, they yet reproduce and wage against each other senseless war. Ware their ships should you wander north and east of here, for they wield weapons diverse and strange, and bring you can we no succor within the bourne of their space."|91|0
units.english: "Robotic starships, and autonomous factories to create them. Though now directed by no living being, they yet reproduce and wage against each other senseless war. Ware their ships should you wander north and east of here, for they wield weapons diverse and strange, and bring you can we no succor within the bourne of their space."
units.italian: "Navi stellari robotiche, e fabbriche autonome che le creano. Sebbene ora non siano dirette da alcun essere vivente, si riproducono ancora e si fanno guerra insensata fra loro. Guardatevi dalle loro navi se vagate a nord e a est di qui, ché impugnano armi diverse e strane, e nessun soccorso possiamo recarvi entro i confini del loro spazio."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"You mentioned 'crimes.' What crimes did they commit?"|93|0
units.english: "You mentioned 'crimes.' What crimes did they commit?"
units.italian: "Hai parlato di 'crimini'. Che crimini hanno commesso?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"Of that we shall not speak, lest awaken in you we the desire to in their footsteps follow. But you may observe the wreckage of their abominations and take warning."|94|0
units.english: "Of that we shall not speak, lest awaken in you we the desire to in their footsteps follow. But you may observe the wreckage of their abominations and take warning."
units.italian: "Di questo non parleremo, che non si risvegli in voi il desiderio di seguirne le orme. Ma potete osservare i rottami delle loro abominazioni e trarne avvertimento."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"Of that we shall not speak, lest awaken in you we the desire to in their footsteps follow. But you may observe the wreckage of their abominations and take warning."|98|0
units.english: "Of that we shall not speak, lest awaken in you we the desire to in their footsteps follow. But you may observe the wreckage of their abominations and take warning."
units.italian: "Di questo non parleremo, che non si risvegli in voi il desiderio di seguirne le orme. Ma potete osservare i rottami delle loro abominazioni e trarne avvertimento."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"You mentioned 'thinking war machines.' What are those?"|100|0
units.english: "You mentioned 'thinking war machines.' What are those?"
units.italian: "Hai parlato di 'macchine da guerra pensanti'. Che cosa sono?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"Robotic starships, and autonomous factories to create them. Though now directed by no living being, they yet reproduce and wage against each other senseless war. Ware their ships should you wander north and east of here, for they wield weapons diverse and strange, and bring you can we no succor within the bourne of their space."|101|0
units.english: "Robotic starships, and autonomous factories to create them. Though now directed by no living being, they yet reproduce and wage against each other senseless war. Ware their ships should you wander north and east of here, for they wield weapons diverse and strange, and bring you can we no succor within the bourne of their space."
units.italian: "Navi stellari robotiche, e fabbriche autonome che le creano. Sebbene ora non siano dirette da alcun essere vivente, si riproducono ancora e si fanno guerra insensata fra loro. Guardatevi dalle loro navi se vagate a nord e a est di qui, ché impugnano armi diverse e strane, e nessun soccorso possiamo recarvi entro i confini del loro spazio."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	You are interrupted as one of the Korath who inhabit this ringworld walks by, and the Quarg says, "Friend Korath, meet the human."|104|0
units.english: You are interrupted as one of the Korath who inhabit this ringworld walks by, and the Quarg says, "Friend Korath, meet the human."
units.italian: Siete interrotti mentre uno dei Korath che abitano questo mondo ad anello passa accanto, e il Quarg dice: "Amico Korath, incontra l'umano."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"<first> <last>," you say, holding out a hand automatically. The Korath does not shake your hand, but instead greets you by holding up both hands, palms toward you. It says something in its own language, then hurries away.|105|0
units.english: "<first> <last>," you say, holding out a hand automatically. The Korath does not shake your hand, but instead greets you by holding up both hands, palms toward you. It says something in its own language, then hurries away.
units.italian: "<first> <last>," dite, tendendo una mano d'istinto. Il Korath non vi stringe la mano, ma vi saluta sollevando entrambe le mani, con i palmi verso di voi. Dice qualcosa nella sua lingua, poi si allontana in fretta.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	The Quarg says to you, "One faction among the Korathi sought peace. 'Korath Efreti,' they name themselves, which means 'Korath Friends.' They are under our protection and intend you no harm. But, they have not your language; here humans are rare. Another question have you?"|106|0
units.english: The Quarg says to you, "One faction among the Korathi sought peace. 'Korath Efreti,' they name themselves, which means 'Korath Friends.' They are under our protection and intend you no harm. But, they have not your language; here humans are rare. Another question have you?"
units.italian: Il Quarg vi dice: "Una fazione fra i Korathi cercò la pace. Si fanno chiamare 'Korath Efreti', che significa 'Amici dei Korath'. Sono sotto la nostra protezione e non intendono farti alcun male. Ma non hanno la tua lingua; qui gli umani sono rari. Un'altra domanda hai?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"Will the friendly Korath let me purchase their technology?"|108|0
units.english: "Will the friendly Korath let me purchase their technology?"
units.italian: "I Korath amichevoli mi lasceranno comprare la loro tecnologia?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"Why don't you destroy the robots, if they're such a threat?"|109|0
units.english: "Why don't you destroy the robots, if they're such a threat?"
units.italian: "Perché non distruggete i robot, se sono una tale minaccia?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"No, but I'm glad to meet you."|111|0
units.english: "No, but I'm glad to meet you."
units.italian: "No, ma sono lieto di conoscerti."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	"Visit their worlds," says the Quarg. "Though they learn not your words, you are clever and may speak as does one without words, by pointing at things." You thank it for its time, and the crowd of Quarg that has been gawking at you slowly disperses.|113|0
units.english: "Visit their worlds," says the Quarg. "Though they learn not your words, you are clever and may speak as does one without words, by pointing at things." You thank it for its time, and the crowd of Quarg that has been gawking at you slowly disperses.
units.italian: "Visitate i loro mondi," dice il Quarg. "Sebbene non imparino le vostre parole, siete scaltro e potete parlare come fa chi è senza parole, indicando le cose." Lo ringraziate del tempo, e la folla di Quarg che vi fissava si disperde lentamente.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Kuwaru Efreti|	It clicks its teeth together, which might be the Quarg equivalent of laughter. "It was hoped that one faction of robots would destroy the other, and leave for us less work to do, but they are sadly too evenly matched. Instead we merely restrain them from expanding, as one isolates a fire one cannot extinguish and for it to burn out waits." You thank it for its time, and the crowd of Quarg that has been gawking at you slowly disperses.|117|0
units.english: It clicks its teeth together, which might be the Quarg equivalent of laughter. "It was hoped that one faction of robots would destroy the other, and leave for us less work to do, but they are sadly too evenly matched. Instead we merely restrain them from expanding, as one isolates a fire one cannot extinguish and for it to burn out waits." You thank it for its time, and the crowd of Quarg that has been gawking at you slowly disperses.
units.italian: Fa scattare i denti l'uno contro l'altro, che potrebbe essere l'equivalente Quarg di una risata. "Si sperava che una fazione di robot distruggesse l'altra, e ci lasciasse meno lavoro da fare, ma purtroppo sono troppo pari. Ci limitiamo invece a trattenerli dall'espandersi, come si isola un fuoco che non si riesce a spegnere e lo si lascia bruciare fino a esaurirsi." Lo ringraziate del tempo, e la folla di Quarg che vi fissava si disperde lentamente.
